caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical, stylized floral design centered on a main vertical stem with six main branches radiating outward. The central stem and branches are colored in red with green accents, and the stem has a pattern of solid yellow dots and a green stripe running up the middle. At the top of the stem is a large yellow flower with fringed edges. On either side at the top are two large red and yellow tulip-shaped flowers with green and yellow details, framed by green leaves. Below these, two medium-sized red and yellow tulip-shaped flowers flank the central stem, each with three green leaves at their base. At the base on both sides are two red downward-facing flowers with pointed yellow centers, flanked by green leaves. The leaves throughout the composition are elongated and green. The background is a solid, light tan color with a faded, aged appearance. The bottom margin of the drawing contains printed text indicating it is from a book plate in a Mennonite hymnal dated 1829.
title: Drawing for Plate 7: From Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
